name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon perches on a wind-carved stone arch with wings half-spread, tail trailing in the breeze, head raised and turned toward the camera with a free, playful gaze.
components.background: a mountaintop eyrie above a sea of clouds, broken wind-carved stone arches, banners and streamers whipping in a bright open sky
components.hoard: drifts of feathers and silk sails, wind chimes and silver bells, shining kites and pennants, glass lenses and polished silver trinkets, jade and cloud-glass gems
components.effects: A few feathers and wisps of cloud drift past on the breeze - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
